study_name.evidence_quote: All the individuals in the present study were from a cohort study among employees of the Kailuan Group Corporation.
study_name.section: Methods — Study cohort and patient characteristics

target_condition.evidence_quote: Hypertension is one of the most prevalent cardiovascular diseases worldwide. To investigate this issue, we carried out comprehensive metagenomic and metabolomic analyses in a cohort of 41 healthy controls, 56 subjects with pre-hypertension, 99 individuals with primary hypertension.

country.evidence_quote: The Kailuan study is a prospective cohort study focusing on the Kailuan community in Tangshan, a large modern city in northern China.
country.section: Methods — Study cohort and patient characteristics

body_site.evidence_quote: Stool samples freshly collected from each participant were immediately frozen at −20 °C and transported to the laboratory with ice pack.
body_site.section: Methods — Stool sample collection and DNA extraction

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: Individuals were also excluded if they had received antibiotics or probiotics within the last 8 weeks.
antibiotics_exclusion_period.section: Methods — Study cohort and patient characteristics

antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit.evidence_quote: Individuals were also excluded if they had received antibiotics or probiotics within the last 8 weeks.
antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit.section: Methods — Study cohort and patient characteristics

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: Bacterial DNA was extracted at Novogene Bioinformatics Technology Co., Ltd using TIANGEN kit according to the manufacturer's recommendations.
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Stool sample collection and DNA extraction

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: All samples were paired-end sequenced on the Illumina platform (insert size 300 bp, read length 125 bp) at the Novogene Bioinformatics Technology Co., Ltd.
sequencing_platform.section: Methods — Metagenomic sequencing and gene catalogue construction
sequencing_platform.notes: Paper states Illumina platform; specific model Illumina HiSeq mentioned in 16S sequencing section.

zigosity.notes: No twin studies or zygosity information reported

age_min.notes: No specific age data reported for human participants

age_max.notes: No specific age data reported for human participants

age_years.notes: Age not reported for human cohort or mice

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Individuals were also excluded if they had received antibiotics or probiotics within the last 8 weeks.
antibiotics_current_use.section: Methods — Study cohort and patient characteristics
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Participants were excluded if they used antibiotics in prior 8 weeks

bmi.notes: BMI mentioned as a variable examined (Additional file 5: Figure S3) but specific values not provided in text

dietary_restriction.notes: No specific dietary restrictions reported for participants

disease.evidence_quote: a cohort of 41 healthy controls, 56 subjects with pre-hypertension, 99 individuals with primary hypertension
disease.notes: Three subgroups defined by blood pressure status

disease_details.notes: Only primary hypertension specified; secondary causes excluded

disease_response_orr.notes: Not applicable; study does not evaluate treatment response

disease_response_pfs.notes: Not applicable; study does not measure progression-free survival

disease_response_pfs_month.notes: Not applicable; study does not measure progression-free survival

disease_response_recist.notes: Not applicable; study does not measure solid tumor response

feces_phenotype.evidence_quote: Bacterial DNA was extracted from stool samples, sequenced on the Illumina platform
feces_phenotype.section: Results — GM diversity and enterotype in pHTN and HTN
feces_phenotype.notes: Study analyzed fecal microbiota from stool samples using metagenomic sequencing

fmt_id.evidence_quote: The donors for microbiota transplantation consisted of two patients of HTN and one normotensive control
fmt_id.section: Results — High BP is transferrable by fecal transplant
fmt_id.notes: Three donors identified; study-specific identifiers not explicitly provided in text

fmt_role.evidence_quote: fecal bacteria from hypertensive patients were transplanted to GF mice; Male GF mice at 8–10 weeks were divided into groups and orally inoculated with stool samples
fmt_role.section: Results — High BP is transferrable by fecal transplant
fmt_role.notes: Human subjects were FMT donors; mice were recipients after procedure

neonatal_birth_weight.notes: Study focuses on adult cohort; no neonatal data

neonatal_delivery_procedure.notes: Study focuses on adult cohort; no neonatal delivery data

neonatal_feeding_method.notes: Study focuses on adult cohort; no infant feeding data

neonatal_gestational_age.notes: Study focuses on adult cohort; no neonatal gestational data

neonatal_preterm_birth.notes: Study focuses on adult cohort; no neonatal preterm data

obgyn_birth_control.notes: No information on oral contraceptive use reported

obgyn_menopause.notes: No menopausal status reported; gender ratio mentioned as discrepant but status not specified

smoker.evidence_quote: Patients suffering from cancer, heart failure, renal failure, smoking, stroke, peripheral artery disease, and chronic inflammatory disease were all excluded.
smoker.section: Results — GM diversity and enterotype in pHTN and HTN
smoker.notes: Smoking was an exclusion criterion; specific smoking status not reported for included subjects

treatment.evidence_quote: All the subjects in the hypertension group were newly diagnosed hypertensive patients prior to antihypertensive treatment. Drugs including statins, aspirin, insulin, metformin, nifedipine, and metoprolol were not used on the patients
treatment.section: Results — GM diversity and enterotype in pHTN and HTN
treatment.notes: Participants were selected to exclude prior medication use to avoid confounding

tumor_staging_ajcc.notes: Not applicable; study does not involve cancer staging

tumor_staging_tnm.notes: Not applicable; study does not involve tumor staging

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: Prevotella and Klebsiella, and disease-linked microbial function; Faecalibacterium, Roseburia, Bifidobacterium enriched in controls
biomarker_name.notes: Multiple biomarkers identified across metagenomic and metabolomic analyses. Presented as lists of differentially abundant genera and metabolites.

biomarker_unit.evidence_quote: relative abundance of gut microbes; SBP and DBP measured in mmHg; Z scores calculated for metabolites
biomarker_unit.notes: Units vary by biomarker type. Abundance normalized to relative amounts or Z-scores; BP in mmHg.

value: P = 0.024 (C vs P); P = 0.04 (C vs H) for gene count
P = 0.023 (C vs P); P = 0.016 (C vs H) for α diversity
biomarker_value.evidence_quote: gene count decreased; Shannon index lower in pHTN and HTN; 48.21% pHTN and 45.45% HTN in enterotype 1
biomarker_value.notes: Values reported as relative changes, percentages, and statistical comparisons. Subgroup analysis shows disease vs control comparisons.

disease_response_os.notes: Study is cross-sectional with no survival follow-up; hypertension outcomes measured at single time point.

disease_response_os_unit.notes: No overall survival data reported in study.

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status not assessed in this hypertension microbiome study.

value: reduced bacteria associated with healthy status
128 genera colonized from HTN donors in mice
110 genera colonized from control donor in mice
Shannon index reduced in HTN mice (P = 0.048)
feces_phenotype_value.evidence_quote: dramatically decreased microbial richness and diversity, Prevotella-dominated gut enterotype, distinct metagenomic composition
feces_phenotype_value.notes: Fecal microbiota phenotypes characterized by metagenomic sequencing; transplant experiments show transferability to germ-free mice.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Not applicable; this is a hypertension study, not a cancer study.

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not applicable; this is a hypertension study, not a cancer study.

value: Cohort from Kailuan Group Corporation employees in Tangshan, northern China
Metagenomic sequencing: 1211 Gb total, 6.18±1.43 million reads per sample
Metabolomic subset: 124 individuals (30 controls, 31 pHTN, 63 HTN)
Germ-free mice transplant: 3 donors (2 HTN, 1 control); recipients n=5 control, n=10 HTN
BP measured by tail-cuff method at 10 weeks post-transplantation
Excluded: antibiotics/probiotics within 8 weeks, cancer, heart failure, renal failure, smoking, stroke

uncurated_metadata.notes: Study design, cohort characteristics, sequencing specifications, and exclusion criteria documented.

host_species.evidence_quote: cohort of 196 Chinese individuals; Male GF mice aged 8–10 weeks; C57BL/6L mice
host_species.section: Methods — Study cohort; Methods — Animal experiments
host_species.notes: Primary study population was human subjects; experimental validation used laboratory mice (C57BL/6L strain).
